change_summary: The paper has been withdrawn, and its full text and PDF replaced by a withdrawal statement. The editor was told the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so the reported results cannot be relied on. The stored copy's main results, such as the 2.1 °C lower peak indoor temperature in green-roofed flats, rest on those records.
evaluation: Your draft takes its key green-roof parameter, the 2.1 °C reduction in daily peak indoor temperature, from Okafor et al. [14] in Section 2.2, and the Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with it. The paper has been withdrawn because its indoor temperature records were processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so its reported results cannot be relied on. Both uses are touched, and since your estimate rests on this value, the impact is high.
recommendation: Stop and raise this with your co-authors or supervisor, because your model sets the green-roof effect to 2.1 °C from Okafor et al. [14], and the withdrawal statement says the indoor temperature records had an incorrect sensor calibration so the reported results cannot be relied on. Then replace that citation and re-check the Discussion claim that your green-roof result scales almost directly with the 2.1 °C reduction.
